bounties.title: [Bounty $750] Improve Qwen3-TTS Code Predictor Accuracy
bounties.body:
📝 Background

The Qwen3-TTS code predictor produces logits for 15 codebook heads during decoding. Improving accuracy while preserving inference throughput benefits end-to-end Qwen3-TTS quality without changing model weights.

🎯 What Success Looks Like
- The Qwen3-TTS end-to-end test passes for the 0.6B and 1.7B models on Wormhole N150 and Blackhole P100a.
- Top-1 and top-5 accuracy meet or exceed the applicable lower bounds in models/demos/audio/qwen3_tts/tests/e2e/model_targets.yaml for each tested configuration.
- The following PCC tests pass for both model sizes on the tested hardware: test_decode_pcc, test_pipeline, test_kv_cache_guard, and test_code_predictor_pcc.
- Submit a results table showing top-1, top-5, and frames/second for each tested card/model pair, comparing the baseline and proposed change. Identify any untested configurations; do not claim support for them.

💡 Problem to Solve

Investigate the code predictor's output precision and accuracy. Implement a change that improves or maintains end-to-end accuracy while avoiding a meaningful frame-rate regression. The implementation should not modify model weights.


🧭 Guidance & Starting Points
- Start with models/demos/audio/qwen3_tts/tt/ttnn_qwen3_code_predictor_decode.py, particularly the codebook-head linear operation.
- Run models/demos/audio/qwen3_tts/tests/e2e/test_e2e.py and the code predictor PCC tests.
- Compare results against models/demos/audio/qwen3_tts/tests/e2e/model_targets.yaml.


This bounty is subject to the [Tenstorrent Bounty Program Terms & Conditions](https://docs.tenstorrent.com/bounty_terms.html).
